visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler in a light-colored long-sleeve shirt and blue shorts stands on a black leather sofa. He is jumping energetically. A woman in a black t-shirt sits beside him. Red devil horn stickers and 'Jump!!' text are overlaid on the frame. (2) The child continues to stand on the sofa, looking towards the woman. In the background, a tuxedo cat sits on a wooden counter behind the sofa. The room is warmly lit with green pendant lamps hanging in the background. (3) The child sits down on the sofa cushion. The woman, with brown hair and glasses, looks at him sternly. Variety text '[氣氛不對]' appears as they interact, and a blue star sticker is briefly on the child's head. (4) Close-up on the child's face, showing a pouting and slightly guilty expression with his mouth tight. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (5) The woman reaches out to pet the child's head as he looks up at her with large eyes. More variety text '[媽媽生氣了]' and '[被原諒了]' appear on screen. (6) The child leans forward, crawling towards the woman. She laughs, her face lighting up with a wide smile. A pink heart emoji appears over them as she pulls him closer.
